title: Can Rabbits Eat Blackberries?
description: It does not replace advice from a rabbit-savvy vet. If your rabbit stops eating, stops pooing, seems in pain or is suddenly unwell, contact a vet…
body:
<div class="wp-block-group alignfull">
<!--
RabbitCare.co.uk blog article block
Page: Can Rabbits Eat Blackberries?
How to use in WordPress:
1) Edit the blog page/post.
2) Add a "Custom HTML" block.
3) Replace the old article content with everything below.

Notes:
- No custom header/nav or footer included.
- Internal links use root-relative URLs.
- Uses the same visual style as the RabbitCare homepage, bedding guide and hay guide.
- Replace the image URLs below with your blackberry images once uploaded.
-->

<section class="rcbk-page alignfull" id="can-rabbits-eat-blackberries">
  <style>
    :root {
      --rc-cream: #fff9ef;
      --rc-cream-2: #f6ead8;
      --rc-sage: #7f9b72;
      --rc-sage-dark: #4e6b45;
      --rc-moss: #2f4a2e;
      --rc-brown: #8a6246;
      --rc-gold: #d7a64b;
      --rc-charcoal: #2d2d2b;
      --rc-muted: #6f6a61;
      --rc-white: #ffffff;
      --rc-danger: #9b3b2f;
      --rc-danger-soft: #fff0eb;
      --rc-shadow: 0 24px 70px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.16);
      --rc-radius-xl: 34px;
      --rc-radius-lg: 24px;
      --rc-radius-md: 16px;
      --rc-max: 1180px;
      --rc-font-heading: Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
      --rc-font-body: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
    }

    .rcbk-page,
    .rcbk-page * { box-sizing: border-box; }

    body,
    .wp-site-blocks,
    .entry-content,
    .wp-block-post-content,
    main { background: #fef4f0 !important; }

    body .wp-site-blocks,
    body .entry-content,
    body .wp-block-post-content,
    body main,
    body article,
    body .wp-block-group,
    body .wp-block-post-content > .wp-block-html {
      margin-top: 0 !important;
      padding-top: 0 !important;
      gap: 0 !important;
      row-gap: 0 !important;
    }

    body .entry-header,
    body .page-header,
    body .wp-block-post-title,
    body h1.wp-block-post-title,
    body .wp-block-post-featured-image { display: none !important; }

    body .wp-site-blocks > * + *,
    body .entry-content > * + *,
    body .wp-block-post-content > * + * { margin-block-start: 0 !important; }

    body .wp-block-html,
    body .entry-content > .wp-block-html,
    body .wp-block-post-content > .wp-block-html {
      margin-top: 0 !important;
      margin-bottom: 0 !important;
      padding-top: 0 !important;
      padding-bottom: 0 !important;
    }

    .rcbk-page {
      position: relative;
      left: calc(50% + 20px);
      width: calc(100vw + 40px);
      max-width: none;
      margin: -120px 0 0 !important;
      padding: 0 !important;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      color: var(--rc-charcoal);
      font-family: var(--rc-font-body);
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at top left, rgba(215, 166, 75, 0.18), transparent 32rem),
        linear-gradient(180deg, var(--rc-cream) 0%, #fffdf8 46%, #fef4f0 100%);
      overflow-x: hidden;
      line-height: 1.68;
    }

    .rcbk-page a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; }

    .rcbk-page a:focus-visible {
      outline: 3px solid rgba(215, 166, 75, 0.9);
      outline-offset: 4px;
      border-radius: 10px;
    }

    .rcbk-wrap { width: min(var(--rc-max), calc(100% - 34px)); margin: 0 auto; }
    .rcbk-narrow { width: min(920px, calc(100% - 34px)); margin: 0 auto; }

    .rcbk-pill {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-size: 0.84rem;
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: 0.04em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .rcbk-pill::before { content: "✦"; color: var(--rc-gold); }

    .rcbk-btns {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 14px;
      align-items: center;
      margin-top: 30px;
    }

    .rcbk-btn {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      min-height: 52px;
      padding: 14px 22px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      font-weight: 900;
      transition: transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease, background 0.25s ease;
    }

    .rcbk-btn:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); }

    .rcbk-btn-primary {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--rc-sage-dark), var(--rc-sage));
      color: #fff;
      box-shadow: 0 18px 38px rgba(79, 112, 70, 0.26);
    }

    .rcbk-btn-secondary {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9);
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.16);
      box-shadow: 0 12px 28px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.10);
    }

    .rcbk-hero {
      padding: 0 0 42px;
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 80% 20%, rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.18), transparent 28rem),
        linear-gradient(180deg, #fff9ef 0%, rgba(255, 249, 239, 0) 100%);
    }

    .rcbk-hero-image-wrap {
      width: 100%;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      background: #fff9ef;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .rcbk-hero-cover { position: relative; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; }

    .rcbk-hero-cover::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background:
        linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(31, 45, 27, 0.68), rgba(31, 45, 27, 0.24) 45%, rgba(31, 45, 27, 0.04)),
        linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18), transparent 45%, rgba(255, 249, 239, 0.12));
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .rcbk-hero-image {
      display: block;
      width: 100%;
      height: auto;
      object-fit: contain;
      object-position: center;
      background: #fff;
      animation: rcbkFadeIn 0.9s ease both;
    }

    .rcbk-hero-title-overlay {
      position: absolute;
      z-index: 2;
      left: max(24px, calc((100vw - var(--rc-max)) / 2));
      bottom: clamp(28px, 8vw, 96px);
      max-width: 720px;
      padding: clamp(20px, 4vw, 38px);
      color: #ffffff;
    }

    .rcbk-hero-title-overlay .rcbk-pill {
      color: #ffffff;
      text-shadow: 0 3px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
    }

    .rcbk-hero-title-overlay h1 {
      margin: 12px 0 12px;
      font-family: var(--rc-font-heading);
      font-size: clamp(3rem, 7vw, 7rem);
      line-height: 0.88;
      letter-spacing: -0.065em;
      color: #ffffff;
      text-wrap: balance;
      text-shadow: 0 5px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.42);
    }

    .rcbk-hero-title-overlay p {
      max-width: 560px;
      margin: 0;
      color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.94);
      font-size: clamp(1.05rem, 2vw, 1.35rem);
      font-weight: 700;
      text-shadow: 0 3px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.36);
    }

    .rcbk-hero-content {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1.05fr 0.95fr;
      gap: 34px;
      align-items: center;
      padding-top: 44px;
    }

    .rcbk-breadcrumb {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      margin-bottom: 18px;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      font-weight: 800;
    }

    .rcbk-breadcrumb a { color: var(--rc-sage-dark); }

    .rcbk-intro-heading {
      margin: 12px 0 16px;
      font-family: var(--rc-font-heading);
      font-size: clamp(2.2rem, 5vw, 4.4rem);
      line-height: 0.98;
      letter-spacing: -0.055em;
      color: var(--rc-charcoal);
      text-wrap: balance;
    }

    .rcbk-hero-subtitle {
      max-width: 720px;
      margin: 0;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: clamp(1.08rem, 2vw, 1.28rem);
    }

    .rcbk-hero-card {
      padding: 28px;
      border-radius: 38px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow);
      backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
    }

    .rcbk-hero-card h2 {
      margin: 0 0 14px;
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      font-size: 1.35rem;
      line-height: 1.18;
    }

    .rcbk-hero-card ul {
      display: grid;
      gap: 12px;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      list-style: none;
    }

    .rcbk-hero-card li {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 32px 1fr;
      gap: 10px;
      align-items: start;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .rcbk-hero-card li::before {
      content: "✓";
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      width: 32px;
      height: 32px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.14);
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-weight: 900;
    }

    .rcbk-quickbar { position: relative; z-index: 4; margin-top: 26px; }

    .rcbk-quickbar-inner {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 14px;
      padding: 16px;
      border-radius: var(--rc-radius-xl);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow);
      backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
    }

    .rcbk-quick {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 62px 1fr;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 14px;
      min-height: 96px;
      padding: 18px;
      border-radius: 24px;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, #fff, #fff8eb);
      transition: transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease;
    }

    .rcbk-quick:hover {
      transform: translateY(-5px);
      box-shadow: 0 16px 34px rgba(83, 61, 42, 0.14);
    }

    .rcbk-quick-icon {
      width: 62px;
      height: 62px;
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      font-size: 2.35rem;
      line-height: 1;
    }

    .rcbk-quick strong {
      display: block;
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      line-height: 1.15;
      font-size: 1.02rem;
    }

    .rcbk-quick span span {
      display: block;
      margin-top: 4px;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      line-height: 1.35;
    }

    .rcbk-section { width: 100%; padding: 72px 0; position: relative; }

    .rcbk-section-header {
      max-width: 780px;
      margin: 0 auto 32px;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .rcbk-section h2,
    .rcbk-final h2 {
      margin: 12px 0 12px;
      font-family: var(--rc-font-heading);
      font-size: clamp(2.2rem, 5vw, 4.6rem);
      line-height: 0.98;
      letter-spacing: -0.055em;
      color: var(--rc-charcoal);
      text-wrap: balance;
    }

    .rcbk-section-header p {
      margin: 0 auto;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: 1.08rem;
      max-width: 680px;
    }

    .rcbk-article-layout {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 320px;
      gap: 28px;
      align-items: start;
    }

    .rcbk-content { display: grid; gap: 24px; }

    .rcbk-panel {
      position: relative;
      padding: clamp(24px, 4vw, 38px);
      border-radius: var(--rc-radius-xl);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.86);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: 0 18px 48px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.10);
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .rcbk-panel::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      width: 190px;
      height: 190px;
      right: -82px;
      top: -92px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.10);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .rcbk-panel > * { position: relative; z-index: 1; }
    .rcbk-panel h2 { margin-top: 0; }

    .rcbk-panel h3 {
      margin: 0 0 10px;
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      font-size: 1.45rem;
      line-height: 1.2;
    }

    .rcbk-panel p {
      margin: 0 0 16px;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: 1.03rem;
    }

    .rcbk-panel p:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }

    .rcbk-list {
      display: grid;
      gap: 12px;
      margin: 22px 0 0;
      padding: 0;
      list-style: none;
    }

    .rcbk-list li {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 38px 1fr;
      gap: 12px;
      align-items: start;
      padding: 15px;
      border-radius: 20px;
      background: rgba(255, 249, 239, 0.9);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.10);
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .rcbk-list li::before {
      content: "✓";
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      width: 38px;
      height: 38px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.14);
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-weight: 900;
    }

    .rcbk-treat-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 18px;
      margin-top: 28px;
    }

    .rcbk-treat-card {
      padding: 24px;
      border-radius: var(--rc-radius-xl);
      background: #ffffff;
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: 0 16px 42px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.10);
      transition: transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease;
    }

    .rcbk-treat-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-6px);
      box-shadow: 0 24px 58px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.15);
    }

    .rcbk-treat-card b {
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      width: 54px;
      height: 54px;
      margin-bottom: 18px;
      border-radius: 22px;
      background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.14);
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-size: 1.2rem;
    }

    .rcbk-treat-card h3 { margin: 0 0 8px; color: var(--rc-moss); font-size: 1.22rem; }
    .rcbk-treat-card p { margin: 0; color: var(--rc-muted); }

    .rcbk-warning {
      padding: 68px 0;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 240, 235, 0.56), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0));
    }

    .rcbk-warning-card {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 0.9fr 1.1fr;
      gap: 28px;
      align-items: center;
      padding: clamp(24px, 5vw, 44px);
      border-radius: 42px;
      background: #ffffff;
      border: 2px solid rgba(155, 59, 47, 0.16);
      box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow);
    }

    .rcbk-warning-card h2 { color: var(--rc-danger); }

    .rcbk-warning-card p {
      margin: 0;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: 1.06rem;
    }

    .rcbk-warning-list {
      display: grid;
      gap: 12px;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      list-style: none;
    }

    .rcbk-warning-list li {
      padding: 18px;
      border-radius: 20px;
      background: var(--rc-danger-soft);
      color: #4a2823;
      font-weight: 800;
    }

    .rcbk-warning-list strong {
      display: block;
      margin-bottom: 4px;
      color: var(--rc-danger);
      font-size: 1.05rem;
    }

    .rcbk-image-split {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 0.95fr 1.05fr;
      gap: 30px;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .rcbk-image-card { position: relative; min-height: 430px; }

    .rcbk-image-card img {
      position: absolute;
      object-fit: cover;
      display: block;
      border: 10px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.82);
      box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow);
      transition: transform 0.35s ease;
    }

    .rcbk-image-card img:hover { transform: rotate(0deg) scale(1.03) !important; }

    .rcbk-img-main {
      width: 78%;
      height: 340px;
      left: 0;
      top: 20px;
      border-radius: 42px;
      transform: rotate(-2deg);
    }

    .rcbk-img-small {
      width: 52%;
      height: 230px;
      right: 0;
      bottom: 0;
      border-radius: 34px;
      transform: rotate(4deg);
      object-fit: contain !important;
      background: #fff9ef;
    }

    .rcbk-prep {
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0), rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.09), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0));
    }

    .rcbk-steps {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 18px;
      margin-top: 28px;
    }

    .rcbk-step {
      padding: 24px;
      border-radius: var(--rc-radius-xl);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.86);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: 0 16px 42px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.10);
    }

    .rcbk-step b {
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      width: 48px;
      height: 48px;
      margin-bottom: 18px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.15);
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-size: 1.15rem;
    }

    .rcbk-step h3 { margin: 0 0 8px; color: var(--rc-moss); font-size: 1.16rem; }
    .rcbk-step p { margin: 0; color: var(--rc-muted); }

    .rcbk-sidebar {
      position: sticky;
      top: 22px;
      display: grid;
      gap: 18px;
    }

    .rcbk-side-card {
      padding: 22px;
      border-radius: 28px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: 0 16px 42px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.10);
    }

    .rcbk-side-card h2 {
      margin: 0 0 14px;
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      font-size: 1.18rem;
      line-height: 1.2;
    }

    .rcbk-side-card ul {
      display: grid;
      gap: 10px;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      list-style: none;
    }

    .rcbk-side-card a {
      display: block;
      padding: 11px 12px;
      border-radius: 16px;
      background: #fff9ef;
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-weight: 850;
      transition: transform 0.2s ease, background 0.2s ease;
    }

    .rcbk-side-card a:hover { transform: translateX(4px); background: #fff4d8; }

    .rcbk-note {
      padding: 20px;
      border-radius: 24px;
      background: #ffffff;
      border-left: 6px solid var(--rc-gold);
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.08);
    }

    .rcbk-note strong { color: var(--rc-moss); }

    .rcbk-benefits-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 18px;
      margin-top: 24px;
    }

    .rcbk-benefit {
      padding: 22px;
      border-radius: 26px;
      background: #ffffff;
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: 0 14px 36px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.08);
    }

    .rcbk-benefit h3 { margin: 0 0 8px; color: var(--rc-moss); font-size: 1.15rem; }
    .rcbk-benefit p { margin: 0; color: var(--rc-muted); }

    .rcbk-final { padding: 70px 0 42px; background: #fef4f0; }

    .rcbk-final-box {
      padding: clamp(28px, 5vw, 52px);
      border-radius: 46px;
      background:
        linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(28, 48, 27, 0.92), rgba(58, 84, 49, 0.86)),
        url("https://rabbitcare.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/Rabbitcare-blackberries-2.png");
      background-size: cover;
      background-position: center;
      color: #ffffff;
      box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow);
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .rcbk-final-box .rcbk-pill,
    .rcbk-final-box h2,
    .rcbk-final-box p {
      color: #ffffff;
      text-shadow: 0 3px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
    }

    .rcbk-final-box p {
      max-width: 780px;
      margin: 0 0 16px;
      font-size: 1.08rem;
    }

    .rcbk-final-box .rcbk-btn-secondary {
      background: #ffffff;
      color: #2f4a2e;
      border: 2px solid #ffffff;
      box-shadow: 0 16px 34px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.22);
      text-shadow: none;
    }

    .rcbk-related {
      padding: 74px 0;
      background: #fff9ef;
      opacity: 1 !important;
      transform: none !important;
      animation: none !important;
    }

    .rcbk-related,
    .rcbk-related * {
      opacity: 1 !important;
      filter: none !important;
      text-shadow: none !important;
    }

    .rcbk-related .rcbk-section-header {
      padding: 30px;
      border-radius: 34px;
      background: #ffffff;
      border: 2px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.22);
      box-shadow: 0 20px 54px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.14);
    }

    .rcbk-related .rcbk-section-header .rcbk-pill { color: #4e6b45 !important; }

    .rcbk-related .rcbk-section-header h2 {
      color: #243320 !important;
      opacity: 1 !important;
      text-shadow: none !important;
    }

    .rcbk-related .rcbk-section-header p {
      color: #332d26 !important;
      opacity: 1 !important;
      text-shadow: none !important;
      font-weight: 650;
    }

    .rcbk-related-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 18px;
      margin-top: 28px;
    }

    .rcbk-related-card {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 92px 1fr;
      gap: 15px;
      padding: 16px;
      border-radius: 24px;
      background: #ffffff !important;
      border: 2px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.22);
      box-shadow: 0 20px 50px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.15);
      transition: transform 0.22s ease, background 0.22s ease;
    }

    .rcbk-related-card:hover { transform: translateY(-5px); background: #fff; }

    .rcbk-related-card img {

            <h3>Choose fresh berries</h3>
            <p>Use fresh, ripe blackberries. Avoid mouldy, dried, cooked or sweetened blackberries.</p>
          </article>

          <article class="rcbk-step">
            <b>2</b>
            <h3>Wash well</h3>
            <p>Rinse blackberries carefully to remove dirt or residue, then drain them well.</p>
          </article>

          <article class="rcbk-step">
            <b>3</b>
            <h3>Start very small</h3>
            <p>Offer a tiny piece or half a blackberry the first time.</p>
          </article>

          <article class="rcbk-step">
            <b>4</b>
            <h3>Feed occasionally</h3>
            <p>Use blackberries as an occasional treat rather than a regular daily food.</p>
          </article>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="rcbk-section rcbk-reveal" id="benefits">
      <div class="rcbk-wrap">
        <div class="rcbk-section-header">
          <span class="rcbk-pill">Treat benefits</span>
          <h2>Benefits and signs your rabbit enjoys blackberries</h2>
          <p>
            When given in moderation, blackberries can add variety and make treat time enjoyable. Even if your rabbit loves them, fruit should always be limited.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div class="rcbk-benefits-grid">
          <article class="rcbk-benefit">
            <h3>Adds variety</h3>
            <p>A blackberry can add occasional variety to a hay-based diet.</p>
          </article>

          <article class="rcbk-benefit">
            <h3>Small amounts of nutrients</h3>
            <p>Blackberries contain some vitamins and plant nutrients, but they should not replace leafy greens or hay.</p>
          </article>

          <article class="rcbk-benefit">
            <h3>Easy to portion</h3>
            <p>Their small size makes blackberries easier to portion than many larger fruits.</p>
          </article>

          <article class="rcbk-benefit">
            <h3>Bonding treat</h3>
            <p>Many rabbits eagerly take blackberry, making it useful for positive, gentle interaction.</p>
          </article>

          <article class="rcbk-benefit">
            <h3>Signs they enjoy it</h3>
            <p>Your rabbit may run over quickly, sniff eagerly, nibble enthusiastically or search for more.</p>
          </article>

          <article class="rcbk-benefit">
            <h3>Still limit treats</h3>
            <p>Even enthusiastic rabbits should only have blackberries occasionally to keep their diet balanced.</p>
          </article>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>



    <section class="rcbk-faq rcbk-reveal" id="faqs" aria-label="Rabbit blackberry FAQs">
      <div class="rcbk-narrow">
        <div class="rcbk-panel">
          <div class="rcbk-section-header">
            <span class="rcbk-pill">FAQs</span>
            <h2>Rabbit blackberry FAQs</h2>
            <p>Quick answers to common questions about feeding blackberries to rabbits safely.</p>
          </div>

          <div class="rcbk-faq-list">
            <details class="rcbk-faq-item">
              <summary>Can rabbits eat blackberries safely?</summary>
              <p>Yes, rabbits can eat blackberries safely in small amounts. Blackberries are still fruit, so they should only be an occasional treat and should never replace hay, water, leafy greens or a balanced rabbit diet.</p>
            </details>

            <details class="rcbk-faq-item">
              <summary>How many blackberries can I give my rabbit?</summary>
              <p>A sensible guide is one small blackberry once or twice per week at most. If your rabbit has never eaten blackberries before, start with a tiny piece or half a blackberry and watch their appetite, poo and behaviour afterwards.</p>
            </details>

            <details class="rcbk-faq-item">
              <summary>Can rabbits eat blackberry seeds?</summary>
              <p>The tiny seeds inside fresh blackberries are generally fine for rabbits to eat as part of a small blackberry portion. Avoid dried blackberries, jams, desserts, sweetened foods and processed blackberry products.</p>
            </details>

            <details class="rcbk-faq-item">
              <summary>Can baby rabbits eat blackberries?</summary>
              <p>Baby rabbits should not be given sugary fruit treats like blackberries. Young rabbits need an age-appropriate diet based around hay, suitable pellets and careful gradual food introductions.</p>
            </details>

            <details class="rcbk-faq-item">
              <summary>What should I do if my rabbit eats too many blackberries?</summary>
              <p>Stop offering blackberries and watch your rabbit closely for changes in appetite, poo, behaviour or signs of discomfort. If your rabbit stops eating, stops pooing, seems bloated or becomes unwell, contact a rabbit-savvy vet urgently.</p>
            </details>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="rcbk-final rcbk-reveal">
      <div class="rcbk-wrap rcbk-final-box">
        <span class="rcbk-pill">Final thoughts</span>
        <h2>Blackberries can be a safe occasional treat for rabbits</h2>
        <p>
          Rabbits can eat blackberries in small amounts, and many rabbits enjoy their sweet taste and soft texture. However, blackberries are still fruit, so they should only be offered occasionally.
        </p>
        <p>
          Keep portions tiny, avoid dried or processed blackberry foods, and watch your rabbit’s digestion when introducing anything new. A rabbit’s diet should still be based mainly on hay, with fresh vegetables and leafy greens forming the rest of their daily food.
        </p>
